description: Source-1 core entity set for Geppetto Desktop (hammer-entity-registry-fgd-json). FGD-like registry in JSON: loading a new registry file adds entities without code changes. Every class implicitly accepts the base keyvalues classname (string), targetname (string), parentname (target), angles (angle) and spawnflags (int); they are not repeated per class.
name: source1-core
